extra.reason: Resolved via AskUserQuestion: Postgres container in CI.

P1 server data layer done: node-postgres + drizzle behind createServerFn, drizzle-kit migrations replacing the browser migrator, single-user/no-auth. Plus schemas/services/api restructure, drizzle-zod validators, t3-env. Verified: typecheck/lint/49 tests/build green, client bundle free of server code, db:migrate + schema creation smoke-tested against real Postgres. Full UI round-trip tracked as Playwright e2e follow-up.

Playwright e2e set up: dedicated container (testcontainers, :5440) + dev server (:3100) isolated from dev, POM + auto db-reset fixtures, @smoke tag + test:e2e/test:e2e:smoke scripts, career-create round-trip with DB-binding + reload-persists assertions. Review cycle applied workers:1, reuseExistingServer:false, dynamic truncate, container-leak guard. Verified: smoke passes, typecheck/lint green.
Decided: email-bound invites (plugin default, no fork). Small known audience, leaks of email-bound codes are harmless, no fork to maintain. Recorded in decision 0013.

Structured pino logger delivered: src/lib/logger.ts (prod JSON / dev pino-pretty tree-shaken from prod bundle, redact for secret fields, LOG_LEVEL from process.env with allow-list validation + warn-on-invalid). db/client pool-error handler now logs via pino's {err} serializer (captures error.code) instead of console.error. resolveLevel unit-tested. Design item (3) server-fn boundary logging re-scoped to gf-fwi.13 (prod-gated). Reviewed 2 iterations (codex + 3 agents clean); 53 tests + typecheck/lint/build green.

Error-logging request middleware delivered: src/start.ts (Start instance + global errorLogger request middleware logging THROWN server-fn/router errors via dynamically-imported pino then rethrow; CSRF re-added since defining start.ts disables Start's auto server-fn CSRF). handle-request-error.ts (log-and-rethrow helper, logger injected for client-safety) + is-loggable-error.ts (skips redirect/notFound control flow + sub-5xx Responses), both unit-tested. 5xx-Response-RESULT logging deferred to gf-fwi.12 (owns it, trigger note added). Reviewed 2 iterations (codex + 5 agents, all converged); 58 tests + typecheck/lint/build green; client bundle verified pino-free.

Wide-events canonical-log-line middleware delivered: one structured 'request' line per request (reqId from cf-ray/x-request-id/uuid, pino child, method/path/handlerType/fn/status/durationMs + ALS-accumulated fields). emitRequestLog self-guarding (logging never changes request outcome); runInstrumented lifecycle extracted + unit-tested; request-context ALS (addRequestFields/getRequestLog). Owns 5xx-response logging (gf-fwi.13 gap). Replaced handle-request-error. Reviewed 2 iterations + post-loop + extraction re-review (codex + agents, all clean); 72 tests + build green, client bundle clean; smoke-verified end-to-end (router GET / -> one INFO line). Follow-ups: gf-fwi.14, gf-fwi.15.

Auth core delivered + reviewed (3 loop iterations + delta pass, all gates green). Better Auth /minimal + admin + tanstackStartCookies + cookieCache on a catch-all route (static import + server-only marker), 4 auth tables + migration, env hardening, auth client, dev compose + scripts, schema integration test. Live sign-up/session smoke + 35/35 integration green.

Email transport landed (sendEmail + planEmailTransport branching: dev log / Cloudflare SMTP / SMTP_URL fallback, env vars, unit tests). React Email template rendering deferred to gf-fwi.2.5, where the verification/reset call sites give templates something to render into; note recorded on 2.5.

Invite-gated registration landed: better-auth-invitation-only before-signup gate, DB-backed inviteStore over invite_pending (SHA-256-hashed keys, sweep-on-set), invitation table + migration 0002, first-user-admin bootstrap via enabled-as-function gate, inviteOnlyClient, resetDb TRUNCATE, 18 integration tests. Reviewed via review-cycle (2 iters) + pr-review-toolkit (5 agents) + codex; all findings fixed (fail-open hardening, key hashing, footgun docs). Bootstrap-race hardening deferred to gf-fwi.2.7. Gates green.

Wired email verification + password reset to the transport: React Email templates (config-driven, px-safe) rendered via @react-email render+toPlainText; sendVerificationEmail/sendResetPassword callbacks await the send; boot-time assertEmailTransportConfigured guards the Better-Auth-swallows-rejections case; reset email links to app /reset-password?token= (page in gf-fwi.2.6). Deferred: gf-1xo (SMTP verify at boot). 8 new tests; full gate green.
Stage 3'-b complete: browser UI auth e2e (sign-up/login/forgot/reset via real forms, data-hydrated marker) + immediate session revocation (cookieCache disabled), reviewed and green
Sign-out control added: header SignOutButton gated to the _app subtree; signs out, invalidates the router, returns to /login. e2e drives the real control. Failed-sign-out feedback deferred to gf-vy9.
Toast system added: Intent UI sonner Toaster (themed via next-themes) mounted in root Providers; shared jsdom matchMedia stub + render test. Unblocks gf-vy9.

Client error-feedback layer shipped (hybrid). Isomorphic logger (pino browser:{asObject:true} + import.meta.env.SSR guard; client level via VITE_LOG_LEVEL; redact list preserved server-side, browser build can't redact so logError only takes the caught error; logError never throws). logError(cause,message) wired into the 4 auth-form catches (log + keep inline NETWORK_ERROR_MESSAGE, nav still blocked), the sign-out button (toasts SIGN_OUT_FAILED_MESSAGE on failure), and RootError (extracted to src/components/root-error.tsx; curated UNEXPECTED_ERROR_MESSAGE instead of raw error.message — INFO-DISCLOSURE fix; logs on SSR render + client effect). Browser logger is DEV-CONSOLE ergonomics only; prod client+server error sink is Sentry, deferred to gf-yru. /api/log and a logging server fn explicitly rejected. Reviewed 2 iterations; typecheck/lint/unit 95/integration 62/e2e 8/build+leak grep all green.
